templates.description: Mask-based SDXL inpaint workflow using the Lustify SDXL NSFW inpainting checkpoint. Use this as a second pass on a base avatar image to repaint clothing or body areas inside a white mask while preserving the rest of the image.

variables.name: positive_prompt
variables.description: Prompt for the masked area only, such as the outfit, skin repair, fabric, and local lighting.

variables.name: input_image
variables.description: Base avatar image to inpaint. Pixels outside the mask are preserved.

variables.name: mask_image
variables.description: Black/white mask image. White is repainted; black is preserved. The mask should match the source image size.

variables.name: mask_channel
variables.description: Mask image channel to read. Use red for black/white masks or alpha for transparent-mask PNGs.

variables.name: grow_mask_by
variables.description: Pixel growth around the mask before inpainting.

variables.name: checkpoint_name
variables.description: Local Lustify SDXL inpainting checkpoint filename.

variables.name: sampler_name
variables.description: ComfyUI sampler name.

variables.name: scheduler
variables.description: ComfyUI scheduler name.

variables.name: negative_prompt
variables.description: Prompt terms to suppress inside the masked area.

variables.name: avatar_name
variables.description: Filesystem-safe avatar name used in output filenames.

variables.name: seed
variables.description: Sampler seed. Use null for runtime randomization.

variables.name: steps
variables.description: Sampler step count.

variables.name: cfg
variables.description: Classifier-free guidance scale.

variables.name: denoise
variables.description: Inpaint denoise strength. Lower values preserve the original image; higher values obey the outfit/body prompt more strongly.

defaults.negative_prompt: out of mask changes, changed face, changed hands, changed background, extra fabric, broken straps, distorted body, distorted anatomy, blurry, low quality, watermark, text, child, teen, underage
